sources.title: Learning From Data — Caltech online course (Yaser Abu-Mostafa), 18 lectures + homework
sources.covers: Lecture topics: the learning problem, is learning feasible (Hoeffding/probability approximation), training versus testing, theory of generalization (growth function, VC bound), the VC dimension, bias-variance tradeoff, validation, regularization. Covers empirical risk, generalization bounds, VC dimension and bias-variance.
sources.access: Free recorded Caltech course with slides, homework and a per-topic video index; no registration. Stability and out-of-distribution generalization are not in the lecture list.

evidence.finding: The page describes a real Caltech course with free recorded lectures and homework; the lecture list runs from 'The Learning Problem' through 'Theory of Generalization', 'The VC Dimension' and 'Bias-Variance Tradeoff'.

topics.topic: 偏差方差与分布外泛化

zh.section: 偏差-方差分解推导；无分布外泛化

topics.note: 偏差方差两边都有；分布外泛化两边都没有课程级材料。；现有zh2第2章偏差方差分解与第12章理论为基础，再读本章偏移类型、可识别假设和加权风险并做练习；不把同分布VC界直接用于任意新分布。；Combine the existing Caltech Bias-Variance lecture with D2L's explicit target/source distribution assumptions, shift correction and limitations; work the detector/correction exercises.

steps.read: 以西瓜书第12章为主线，逐节用南瓜书核对 PAC、VC 维与泛化界的推导。
在PAC/VC之后逐页读稳定性，推导删除一个样本对岭回归预测和泛化界的影响。
复习zh2第2章偏差方差，再读4.9并实现分布判别与重要性加权，记录所需假设。
先看可学习性与泛化理论公开分讲，再学VC维；区分训练误差与泛化误差，并说明置信度、样本量与假设空间大小的关系。
Watch lectures 1–8 in order and do the homework; re-derive the VC bound and bias-variance decomposition.
After the Caltech theory and bias-variance lectures, read Class 6 and rederive the stability bound.
Read the shift chapter, distinguish covariate/label/concept shift, and complete the detection and correction exercises.
